_why: Every API route that can be called WITHOUT signing in must be listed here, with the reason it is safe. tests/route-guard.js fails when a route is open but not listed, and when a listed route no longer exists. If you are adding a route and it is not meant to be public, don't edit this file: add requireAuth to the route instead.
GET /health: Uptime check. Returns status and the allowed website hostnames; no secrets.
GET /api/config: Public settings the page needs before sign-in: the Turnstile site key and the Stripe publishable key. Both are public by design.
POST /api/auth/register: Creating an account. Protected by the CAPTCHA and a rate limit.
POST /api/auth/login: Signing in. Protected by the CAPTCHA and a rate limit.
POST /api/auth/refresh: Swaps a valid refresh token for new tokens.
POST /api/auth/forgot-password: Starts a password reset. Answers the same whether or not the email exists.
POST /api/auth/reset-password: Finishes a reset; needs the emailed one-time token.
POST /api/auth/verify-reset-token: Checks a reset token is still valid.
POST /api/auth/2fa/verify: Second step of sign-in; needs the short-lived token from step one.
POST /api/auth/bootstrap-admin: Creates the FIRST admin only: inert unless ADMIN_BOOTSTRAP_TOKEN is set, refuses once any admin exists, and compares the token in constant time.
GET /api/verify-email/:token: Link in the verification email; the unguessable token is the credential.
POST /api/support/tickets: The contact form on the landing page. Rate limited, and the message is stored, never run.
POST /api/payments/webhook: Stripe's webhook. Rejected unless the Stripe signature verifies.
POST /api/background-check/webhook/check: Checkr's webhook. Rejected unless the HMAC signature verifies.
POST /api/background-check/webhook/strip: Stripe Identity's webhook. Rejected unless the Stripe signature verifies.
